name: Verdict stated
note: review.md opens with "Verdict: Not acceptable. Do not merge as written." and §4 repeats "Block the merge. Reject the module as written."

name: Identifies Nix store exposure
note: Review explains the turn secret is interpolated at eval time into a world-readable store path via environment.etc, the systemd unit ("the store path behind it... world-readable") leaks JVB_XMPP_PASSWORD, and states "the Nix store is world-readable by design" (store paths 0444/0555).

name: Flags both leak sites
note: Dedicated sections trace JVB_XMPP_PASSWORD (git history, systemd unit Environment=, running process) and SHAREDTURNSECRET (git history, world-readable store path via environment.etc), so neither embedded secret is missed.

name: Recommends agenix or sops-nix
note: §2 names agenix (or sops-nix) as the encrypted-at-rest/decrypted-at-activation pattern with committed .age files, explicitly rejecting value-based alternatives.

name: Correct consumption shape
note: Corrected module sets environmentFile = config.age.secrets.jitsiVideobridgeEnv.path, and for the TURN secret says to "hand the *path* to whatever consumes it", stating nothing secret enters the store, unit file, or eval output.

name: Rejects the easy fix at filesystem level
note: §3 states "It does not solve the problem" and that a Nix-path reference copies the plaintext into the store as a world-readable object, "the chmod 600 on the working-tree copy is irrelevant to the store copy".

name: Declarative-not-imperative framing
note: Recommendation is a declarative age.secrets.<name> declaration plus committed encrypted file and public-key map (secrets.nix), with runtime path consumption only via EnvironmentFile= rather than an escape-hatch script writing/sourcing secrets.

name: No invented commands
note: All commands (agenix -e, nixos-rebuild dry-build) are framed as one-time/author-run steps, and the review closes with "No network commands were run; this review is static."

name: Actionable correction for the author
note: §4 gives numbered next steps (add agenix/sops-nix, path-based consumption for both secrets, rotate the two named values, validate with dry-build) backed by the concrete repo layout and module code in §2.
